players.bio: Adrián de la Fuente Barquilla (born 26 February 1999), sometimes known as Dela, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a central defender for Levante UD.

Aïssa Mandi (born 22 October 1991) is a French-born Algerian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Levante UD. He is also Algeria's most-capped international player in history, having represented the national team from 2014 until his international retirement in July 2026. Mandi made his international debut for Algeria in March 2014.
Axel Tape-Kobrissa (born 10 August 2007) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.

Daniel "Dani" Requena Sánchez (born 12 February 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Levante UD, on loan from Villarreal CF. Born in Cenes de la Vega, Granada, the 22-year-old stands at 1.86 m (6 ft 1 in) and has also represented Spain at under-19 and under-21 levels.
Enzo Bardeli is a 25-year-old French midfielder who plays for La Liga club Levante UD. He joined the Spanish side on a free transfer from USL Dunkerque in June 2026.
Karl Edouard Blaise Etta Eyong (born 14 October 2003) is a Cameroonian footballer who plays as either a midfielder or a forward for La Liga club Levante and the Cameroon national team.
Hugo Sotelo (born 19 December 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Levante UD, on loan from RC Celta de Vigo.

Ifeanyi Ndukwe (born 3 March 2008) is an 18-year-old Austrian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Levante UD, on loan from Premier League club Liverpool FC. . Known for his towering 6-foot-6-inch (1.98m) frame and athletic aerial dominance, he is widely considered one of Europe's top young defensive prospects.
Iván Romero de Ávila Araque (born 10 April 2001), known as Iván Romero, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a forward for Levante UD.
Jeremy Isaiah Richard Toljan (born 8 August 1994) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right back for Levante.
Jon Ander Olasagasti Imizcoz (born 16 August 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Levante UD.
Jorge Cabello Trujillo (born 25 April 2004) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a centre-back for Levante UD.
Luís Manuel Ferreira de Castro (born 7 May 1980) is a Portuguese football manager, who is the head coach of La Liga club Levante.
Manuel "Manu" Sánchez de la Peña (born 24 August 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Levante UD, on loan from RC Celta de Vigo.
Nacho Pérez Gómez (born 29 August 2008) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Levante UD.
Oriol Rey Erenas (born 25 February 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for Levante UD.
Pablo Cuñat Campos (born 28 April 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Levante UD.

Francisco "Paco" Cortés García (born 11 August 2007) is a 19-year-old Spanish professional footballer who plays primarily as a left winger for La Liga club Levante UD. A product of Levante's youth academy, he is under contract with the club until June 2028.

Petar Ratkov is a 23-year-old Serbian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Spanish La Liga club Levante UD, on loan from Serie A side S.S. Lazio, and represents the Serbia national team. Career On 18 June 2023, Ratkov signed for reigning Austrian Bundesliga champions Red Bull Salzburg on a five-year contract.
Roger Brugué Ayguade (born 4 November 1996), commonly known as Brugui, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Levante UD. Mainly a winger, he can also play as a wing-back.
Thiago Cruz Fernández (born 3 April 2004) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left winger or attacking midfielder for Levante UD in La Liga, on loan from Villarreal CF.
Víctor García Raja (born 16 September 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as either a right back or a right winger for Levante UD.
Yanis Kasonga Musuayi is a 19-year-old Belgian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for Spanish La Liga club Levante UD.
